name: ethersflow-agent-trust-gate
description: Verification middleware for AI agents. Forces independent LLMs into adversarial debate to cross-examine agent decisions before execution. Prevents hallucinations and unauthorized side-effects.

tools.name: verify_agent_action
tools.description: Cross-examine and gate autonomous AI agent action decisions (e.g. trades, claims, emails) via federated multi-model consensus prior to execution.

agent_action.description: The proposed action the agent intends to take.

reasoning_chain.description: The reasoning or context leading to this action.

agent_count.description: Number of adversarial audit nodes (2 to 7, default 3).
